connection.title: Connections
connection.empty: No saved connection yet. Fill in the form to add one.
connection.name: Name
connection.passwordSaved: Saved in the keychain (leave empty to keep)
connection.savePassword: Save passwords in the system keychain
connection.trustHostKey: I checked this fingerprint, trust it and retry
connection.confirmDelete: Delete the connection “{name}” and its saved passwords?

tlsHelp.disabled: Data travels in clear text. Only for local servers.
tlsHelp.preferred: Encrypts when the server supports it, without checking its certificate.
tlsHelp.required: Always encrypts; fails if the server has no TLS. The certificate is not checked.
tlsHelp.verify-ca: Encrypts and checks that the certificate is signed by a trusted CA.
tlsHelp.verify-identity: Most secure: also checks that the certificate matches the host name.

session.notMariadb: This server is not MariaDB. Basic features work; MariaDB-specific features are hidden.
session.pickObject: Pick a table or another object in the tree to open it.

errors.DB_ACCESS_DENIED: Access denied: check the user name and password.
errors.DB_UNKNOWN_DATABASE: The default database does not exist.
errors.DB_UNREACHABLE: Cannot reach the server: check the host, port and firewall.
errors.DB_TIMEOUT: The server did not answer in time.
errors.TLS: Secure connection failed: the server certificate could not be verified.
errors.TLS_NOT_SUPPORTED: The server does not support TLS. Choose “Preferred” or “Off”.
errors.AUTH_PLUGIN: This account uses an authentication method Otaria does not support yet.
errors.KEYCHAIN: Could not access the system keychain.
errors.PROFILES_CORRUPT: The saved connections file is damaged.
errors.SSH_TIMEOUT: The SSH server did not answer in time.
errors.SSH_HOST_UNKNOWN: Unknown SSH server. Compare this fingerprint with the server's before trusting it.
errors.SSH_HOST_CHANGED: Warning: the SSH server's key changed since last time. This can be an attack. Trust it only if the server was reinstalled.
errors.SSH_AUTH: SSH login refused: check the user, password or key.
errors.SSH_KEY: Cannot read the SSH private key (wrong path or passphrase?).
errors.NO_PRIMARY_KEY: This table has no primary key, so its rows cannot be edited.
errors.ROW_CONFLICT: A row was changed or deleted by someone else meanwhile. Nothing was saved; reload and try again.
errors.NO_DDL: The definition is not available (missing privilege?).
errors.CONFIRM_RISKY: Confirmation required for a destructive statement.
errors.ALTER_ALGORITHM: The server cannot make this change that way.
errors.INDEX_READ_ONLY: Vector indexes cannot be created or edited in the designer; use the SQL editor.
errors.PLUGIN_UNAVAILABLE: This plugin cannot be installed: it is not listed as available on this server.
errors.EXPORT_FORMAT: This format cannot export a whole database.
errors.EXPORT_TOO_MANY_ROWS: Too many rows for an Excel sheet. Use CSV or JSON.
errors.IMPORT_STATEMENT: The import stopped at a failing statement. The statements before it were applied.
errors.FILE_NOT_UTF8: The file is not UTF-8 text.
errors.CSV_DELIMITER: The delimiter must be one character.
errors.CSV_PARSE: The CSV file could not be read.
errors.IMPORT_ROWS: The server refused rows of the file. Nothing was imported.
errors.COPY_SAME: Pick another database than the source.

object.truncateText: Every row is deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
object.dropText: The object and everything in it are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.

grid.previewHint: These statements run in one transaction: if one fails, nothing is changed.

editor.runHint: Run everything, or the selection (⌘/Ctrl+Enter, F9)
editor.runCurrentHint: Run the statement under the cursor (⌘/Ctrl+Shift+Enter)
editor.hint: Type SQL, then Run. Several statements give several results; use DELIMITER for routine bodies.
editor.confirmText: These statements can delete data or objects. Run them anyway?

versioned.asOfHint: Show the table as it was at this moment (your local time). Past data is read-only.
versioned.rowHistoryHint: Every version of the selected row

sequence.cacheHint: Values already cached by the server are handed out before this one.
sequence.name: Name
sequence.restartPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the current value
sequence.setvalOk: Done: this value is handed out next.
sequence.setvalIgnored: Ignored: SETVAL never goes backwards. Use “Restart with” instead.
sequence.asDefaultHint: Paste this into a column definition so new rows take the next value.
sequence.ddlHint: This statement takes effect immediately and cannot be rolled back.

designer.algo_instant: Tried instantly first (ALGORITHM=INSTANT): the server refuses rather than rebuild the table.
designer.algo_online: Online (ALGORITHM=INPLACE, LOCK=NONE): the table may be rebuilt but stays readable and writable.
designer.algo_default: Server's choice: the table may be copied and writes blocked meanwhile.
designer.ignoredHint: Kept up to date but not used by the optimizer: a safe way to test dropping an index. Switched without rebuilding.
designer.vectorReadOnly: Vector index: can be ignored or removed here, not edited (its options would be lost).

plugins.hint: Only plugins whose library is already on the server can be installed. Others need a package installed on the server itself.
plugins.name: Name
plugins.installHint: The plugin stays installed after a server restart. Requires the INSERT privilege on mysql.plugin.
plugins.notStable: This plugin is not stable (maturity: {maturity}). The server may refuse it depending on plugin_maturity.

transfer.withDrop: Add DROP … IF EXISTS before each CREATE
transfer.sqlHint: The script names no database: it can be loaded into any database.
transfer.importHint: Statements run one after the other in {schema}. The first error stops the import; the statements before it stay applied.
transfer.copyHint: Created if it does not exist. Pick another connection from the open tabs, or another database of this one.
transfer.csvHint: All rows go in one transaction: one bad row and nothing is imported.
